verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is a managed database service, so compliance attestations are a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI or any other certification or audit report. Adjacent security controls (SSO, table/column roles, private networking, BYOC data residency) are different features and do not count as documented attestations.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, compliance attestations (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI) are documented so security review does not stall the rollout
